title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne Astir, buze bulevardit te ri! 107,000 €

title_en: 1+1 apartment in Astir, on the edge of the new boulevard! €107,000
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Astir, on the edge of New Boulevard, in the Molla complex. The apartment is located on the 8th floor of a new building with an elevator.
